integrity: Proof is mathematical and self-contained; computational code independently checks a finite selection by original-basis rank calculations. Historical priority is qualified by limited access to some full-text portions; no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact joint enumerator assumes an elementary-abelian underlying group and a finite coefficient field containing all p-th roots of unity, with coefficient characteristic distinct from p. No defining-characteristic or general non-elementary-group claim is made. The finite verification covers eight binary examples over F3 and does not establish the unrestricted theorem.
title: Joint multiplication-rank spectra of finite Alexander-quandle algebras
